security_contract.source_access: read-only GitHub App installation token with pull-requests:read and issues:read, restricted to the three source repositories
security_contract.sink_access: the Engineering-System workflow GITHUB_TOKEN only; contents:write, pull-requests:write and actions:write are not granted to the source token
security_contract.execution: source PR branches, artifacts and bodies are never checked out or executed; reviews and comments are stored only as untrusted Signals
security_contract.approval: intake never approves, merges, closes, adjudicates or converts a Signal into a Finding, Rule or Verification

notes: The registry is configuration, not proof that the GitHub App has been installed or authorized.
The collector is disabled until EGM_REVIEW_APP_CLIENT_ID and EGM_REVIEW_APP_PRIVATE_KEY are configured in the Engineering-System repository.
Only pull requests targeting each source repository's default branch are collected.
